desc:
🧬 ANOMALY MYSTERY 🧬
Something got loose in the hospital. One of you isn't a patient anymore.

🩸 ANOMALY – hunt. Bite, crawl through the vents, SCREECH to stun the ward, drop a FALSE CORPSE, or wear the SKIN of your last victim.
💉 DOCTOR – the only one with a revolver. Find the Anomaly. Shoot the wrong patient and you're done.
🏃 INNOCENT – hide, crouch, run. If the Doctor falls, grab the gun and become the hero.

🪙 Grab coins every round – win or lose, you keep your bag.
🔦 150 seconds. No second chances.

Who's the Anomaly? Find out before it finds you. 👁️

👍 Like & ⭐ Favorite for updates!
